_comment: Every app-visible change serial 7 makes against serial 6 (scripts/validate.py --declared ci/serial7-declared.json --baseline ci/serial3-baseline.json --previous-ref <serial 6>).

changes.reason: New: rootless ID ranges for the SSH user (James 2026-10-13, Alpine: rootless Podman failed to unpack lscr.io/linuxserver/calibre-web with 'potentially insufficient UIDs or GIDs available in user namespace (requested 0:42 for /etc/gshadow)'). BusyBox adduser gives a new user no /etc/subuid or /etc/subgid entry, so any image with a file owned by a non-root id fails. Installs shadow-uidmap (newuidmap, newgidmap), then adds <user>:<start>:65536 to each file that has no entry for the user, the start past every existing range (at least 100000), so it never overlaps. An existing entry is left alone. CI removes the user's entries, adds another user's 100000:65536, and checks the user gets 165536:65536 once in each file.

New: the same for Debian and Ubuntu, with uidmap (newuidmap, newgidmap). Their useradd and adduser normally add the range; a user created another way (an image's own user, a system or directory user) has none, and this adds it. Also run in the su -c form on debian:12.
New: the same for every other Linux (Fedora and EL, Arch, openSUSE and the rest), whose shadow package already has newuidmap: only the missing ranges are added.

New: podman system migrate as the SSH user, so rootless Podman uses the new ID ranges (its own error says to run it). The app runs it after podman.rootless-subids, then restarts Podman's API service (serial 6's restart lines). CI stubs podman and checks it was asked.
